# Draft:Garret Ward (Army Infantryman)

Garrett Devon Ward is a currently serving United States Army Infantryman. After completing one station unit training (OSUT) in  Ft. Benning GA he was assigned to 3rd Battalion 126th Infantry regiment, where he was assigned to a weapons squad. He currently serves as an assistant gunner to an M240L machine gun. He is the team leader for Bear gun, 2nd Platoon, Bravo company.
